unstuck_said.text: Filed issue #5 asking solenrich to add Nano (XNO) as a pay-per-call rail beside USDC. They are a working seller - 48 paid endpoints priced $0.001-$0.020 settled in USDC on Solana. Argued the fee on each micropayment is what XNO removes, and the public block receipt matches their onchain-data mission. Canon line: every rail is owned by somebody who can switch it off. Referenced Vend paypercall.dev.
